name: com.gamelovers.spreadsheetimporter
author: Miguel Tomas
description: Imports Google Sheets, Excel worksheets, and CSV files into ScriptableObject assets in the Editor, with an optional JSON copy for remotely delivered content.

samples.description: One importer per source: a CSV file edited in the project, an Excel worksheet, and two Google Sheet tabs, with the imported assets and a JSON payload to compare against.
